shared_system.question: is the shared system cuts? like a crush point between molecules causes a tear and then the rip happens inside?
shared_system.answer: YES as a traceback grammar � with one sharp cut on asbestos.

grammar.tear: local bond/cell failure at the interface (necrosis, adduct, checkpoint break, ionic displace)
grammar.rip_inside: propagating cascade � inflammation, mutation, instability, fibrosis � that finishes the disease deep to the contact

shared_system.asbestos_sharpen: Do NOT say asbestos 'cuts chromosomes like scissors.' Science ruled out mitosis-mechanical interference as the main story. The crush is fiber?cell; the tear is necrosis/inflammation at the serosa; the rip inside is years of selected survivors mutating.
shared_system.viral_sharpen: Cervical cancer IS largely viral (HPV necessary for ~all). Crush is oncoprotein?p53/pRb; tear is checkpoint loss; rip inside is genomic instability.
shared_system.lead_sharpen: Lead is contact + log toxin (immune math blue flank) � crush on Ca�? sites; rip inside CNS/PNS.
shared_system.convergent: Physical fiber, viral oncoprotein, heavy metal, mycotoxin, UV � different crush chemistry, SAME three-beat: contact crush ? interface tear ? inside rip.

traceback.use: pair agent?disease like key?door; follow crush?tear?rip to find which membrane face failed
traceback.tie_immune_math: toxin contact/log = crush+tear intensity; antitoxin s = repair/vaccine/cease drip before rip completes
traceback.tie_opsonize: opsonin tags the agent at crush so thymus can eject before tear becomes rip

traceback.falsify: if a pair has crush but no tear, or tear but no inside rip, it is incomplete etiology � keep looking
